ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK( Date_of_Birth__c )), NOT(ISBLANK( Joining_Date__c )), OR( Joining_Date__c <= Date_of_Birth__c , Joining_Date__c < ( Date_of_Birth__c + 18*365) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Joining Date must be after Date of Birth and employee must be at least 18 years old
